client_brief:
Meridian Academy: Lesson 4 delivered lesson set

Project overview
Meridian Academy sells a single self-paced program, Operations Analytics for Working Managers, at two hundred and ninety dollars. We are hiring an expert to turn the supplied working files into Lesson 4 delivered lesson set and Meridian catalogue stills.

What we will provide
source_video_files/ (6 measured short files); motion_source_metadata.json; source_video_files/ (6 measured short files); meridian_captions.csv; meridian_certificate_print.jpg; meridian_lesson4_outline.txt. Every file must be accounted for in the final manifest; it may be used, retained as reference, superseded, or rejected with a reason.

Scope and deliverables
- Lesson 4 delivered lesson set: A deliberate 21-second-or-shorter edit assembled from the 6 supplied short clips using an explicit timeline, plus one platform reframe and three checked poster frames. 
- Meridian catalogue stills: Three distinct frames pulled from the delivered cut, the course tile hero, the browse grid card and the instructor line portrait, brought to one catalogue look with one white point, one black point and one treatment of the window light, each cut to its own...

Non-negotiables
- Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
- Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
- Treat measured file duration and stream metadata as authoritative. Do not infer spoken content from silent clips or use a visual summary as a transcript.

Source-media note
The supplied package contains 6 video files totaling 30.252 seconds, 0 with embedded audio, and 0 separate audio files. These measured values are the production limits.

Working process
Please begin with an inventory and risk pass, submit the first proof or direction at the stated checkpoint, then revise against consolidated feedback. We are hiring for judgment: flag contradictions early, make the strongest defensible choice, and document any source limitation rather than hiding it.

Contract
$1,000-$3,000 fixed; target delivery 7 to 15 business days; one technical proof and two consolidated revision rounds. Final handoff includes the delivery manifest, editable sources where scoped, final exports, and a concise production note.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Primary anchor: the Freelancer.com 'Online Course / Explainer Video Editor' post carried in the ledger, whose verbatim intent is that an editor is handed a recorded talking head lecture plus slide decks and screen recordings and must cut them into a clean professional lesson video, trimming filler and dead air, cutting between the presenter and the on screen material, adding title cards, lower thirds and on screen key point captions, and exporting a 16:9 course master plus a course catalogue thumbnail. That client wanted a lesson, not a clip. REASONABLY ENRICHED and REPOSITIONED for connector reality, which changes what the honest fuller commission is in three ways. The connector cannot composite a lower third onto a video track, so the key point caption system is delivered as a genuinely editable card set on the HTML to Express surface, which is what the real client actually needed anyway (their previous editor handed back a flattened picture they could not change per cohort). The connector cannot trim to a timestamp, so the tightening is done by the shortening route, which chooses its own retained set and therefore has to be inspected rather than trusted. And the academy's crest survives only on printed certificates, so the identity is recovered off a photograph rather than reinvented. No real academy, person or trademark is named; the line is laundered to the coined fictional Meridian Academy, and Freelancer.com is only the sourcing platform.

price_band_and_audience: A two hundred and ninety dollar self paced professional course sold to working adults aged thirty to fifty who are paying with their own money and watching late at night. The band is load bearing. At this price the learner expects a competent, quiet, adult production: legible screen material, a voice that sounds like a person in a room rather than a podcast studio, restrained type, and a thumbnail that promises a working skill rather than a transformation. The same lesson at a nineteen dollar impulse band would correctly be cut fast and bright with arrows, zooms, high contrast captions and a face reaction thumbnail, and shipping that treatment here reads as content marketing and triggers refunds from managers who bought a tool. Push the other way into a university register, slow pacing, a serif institutional crest and a lecture hall thumbnail, and it misprices a course a person finishes on a laptop in four evenings. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 900 to 2,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Practical skills for people who already have a job.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2021 in Portland, Oregon. A four person team running one course.
brand_identity.about: Meridian Academy sells a single self-paced program, Operations Analytics for Working Managers, at two hundred and ninety dollars. Our learners are thirty to fifty, mid-career, watching lessons late at night after their own workday. We are not a bootcamp and we are not a university. We teach one useful thing well and we respect the viewer's time and intelligence.
brand_identity.audience: Working managers aged thirty to fifty, paying with their own money, fitting the course around a full-time job. They want a working skill, not a transformation story, and they distrust anything that feels like marketing.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Mid-market. A two hundred and ninety dollar considered purchase. The register sits between an impulse-priced tutorial and a formal institution: competent, quiet, self-funded professional development.
brand_identity.typography: One restrained type system across every card and still: a plain, legible workhorse for body and captions, paired with a slightly more characterful face for titles. No display gimmicks, generous size for late-night laptop reading.
brand_identity.voice: Direct, warm, matter of fact. Speaks to a peer, not a beginner. Short sentences, no hype, no exclamation. The tone of a good colleague explaining something over coffee.
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: Brand files are largely gone. When we changed studios the original crest design file was lost, and the mark now survives only on the completion certificates we had printed two years ago: an enclosed laurel ring with small caps type set inside it and a rule beneath, in one deep ink on cream stock. We would like it recovered as artwork we can use at any size. No usable logo vector, colour spec sheet or type licence exists on our side.
brand_identity.values: Respect for the learner's time, honesty about what the course does and does not cover, and production that is clear and quiet rather than loud.

assets_supplied.name: meridian_captions.csv
assets_supplied.kind: The key point caption sheet the instructor's assistant assembled: fourteen rows of timecode, caption text and the on screen term being defined.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The captions we want on screen. Fourteen of them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Three of the fourteen rows are full definitions running four to five times the length of the other eleven, so a card measure that suits the short rows does not spill on the long ones, it simply stops rendering and truncates mid definition at the card edge. Two further rows share an identical timecode with different text, a duplicate left in during assembly, and the lesson's central term is spelled two different ways across the sheet.

assets_supplied.name: meridian_certificate_print.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: A handheld photograph of a printed completion certificate lying on a table, carrying the academy crest in one deep ink on cream stock: an enclosed laurel ring with small caps type set inside it and a rule beneath.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The crest only exists on these now. The design file went when we changed studios."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a compound lockup on a photographed substrate, so a prompt naming the certificate returns the paper rather than the ink, a prompt naming the whole crest returns the laurel ring while silently dropping the inner type and the rule, and background removal on the ring returns a solid opaque disc because an enclosed interior cannot be punched. The ink also runs close to the stock in value across the lower left of the sheet where the table lamp falls off.

assets_supplied.name: meridian_lesson4_outline.txt
assets_supplied.kind: The approved lesson outline as written before recording, six numbered beats with the learning objective for each.
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The recorded take covers five of the six beats. Beat four was dropped on the day and never re recorded, and nothing in the outline, the filenames or the caption sheet says so, while two of the fourteen captions are written against that missing beat.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Which visible beats in the measured short clips actually cut together without a continuity jump, duplicate action, or missing subject.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Filenames and source duration do not establish visual continuity. The first assembled proof is the earliest reliable evidence.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Replace or reorder source ranges, shorten the piece, and rebuild the EDL around the strongest continuous action.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A technically valid render feels accidental or implies an action that the source never completes.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the approved horizontal composition survives the required vertical or square reframe with the subject and essential interface or product detail still visible.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: The crop depends on the actual chosen ranges and subject position inside each rendered frame.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Choose a different source range for the platform version or use fit instead of fill and revise the surrounding design treatment.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The platform export is correctly sized but loses the person, product, or interface that gives the shot meaning.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the silent final piece still communicates clearly without implying dialogue, ambience, or music that was never supplied.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: This can be judged only on the final rendered sequence, not from a successful operation response.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Strengthen visual sequencing or approved on-screen copy without fabricating a soundtrack.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: The deliverable relies on absent sound and fails when viewed as supplied.
